hairline.$description: Every structural rule and outline. The default border.

emphasis.$description: Active-state rules (current nav item, active TOC entry) and callout leading edges.

contour.$description: Stroke of the backdrop's contour lines; index contours are twice this. Thicker than a hairline so the lines survive the frost blur. Not for the specimen plate, which keeps hairlines.
contour.$deprecated: Unused since the backdrop's contours became hairlines, as on the specimen plate, in 1.17.0; removed in 2.0.0.

offset.$description: Gap between an element and its focus outline, so the ring is measured against the surface.
